title: fix(console): a deployment-level settings value set here reads Modified and offers Reset to default
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgSR1JGX3VuyVmi9T3mtH6Z4)_
domain:ui#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6Cb5R6JDdfyvtj3dPR2

Fixes #30329

Clause-②: yes (widening) — two published language-pack keys in all ten built-in packs: `console.settingsView.sourceBadgeModified` and `console.settingsView.defaultValueHint` (with `{{value}}`).
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：部署级设置页（清单 `scope: 'global'`，如 Setup 的认证页）上管理员自己改过的值，徽标从「继承自全局」改为「已修改」，旁边写出默认值（如「默认：8」，选项显示选项名、开关显示是/否、密码从不显示），并提供「恢复默认」；点了以后照常要按保存才生效。
- 为什么改：原来改过的值看上去像是从别处继承来的，也没有恢复默认按钮，想回到默认只能自己记得默认值或清空输入框。
- 风险与回滚：只动 console 设置页两个文件、十个语言包各加两个键、一个测试文件和 changeset；不动 spec、服务端或元数据。组织级和用户级页面的徽标不变，环境变量锁定的值仍不给恢复。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/apps/console/src/pages/settings/SettingsField.tsx` 的 `sourceBadgeOf`（新增 `modified` 分支）和 `FieldHeader`（恢复按钮条件、默认值提示）→ `SettingsView.tsx` 传入的 `writeScope` → 测试文件新增的 describe。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run apps/console/src/pages/settings/__tests__/SettingsView.unsetAndReset-13145.test.tsx`，预期 9/9 通过（在 main 源码上新加的 3 条失败）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

The card's two Expected bullets, quoted:

> - A value changed here says so, for example 已修改, and names the default.
> - Reset to default is available on it, with Save confirming it as other changes do.

- `SettingsView` passes each row `writeScope`, the scope its Save writes, resolved exactly as the server resolves it in `registerManifest`: the specifier's `scope`, else the manifest's, else the spec default `tenant` (`SettingsManifestSchema` declares `scope: SpecifierScopeSchema.default('tenant')`). The served manifest is the registered one unparsed, so an absent `scope` is the server's `tenant` too.
- `sourceBadgeOf` returns a new `modified` badge when the effective layer is `global` and the row's `writeScope` is `global`; any other `global` or `env` value still reads `Inherited from …`. The `tenant` and `user` arms are unchanged, so the organization and user pages keep their `Overrides …` badges.
- A `modified` row shows `Modified` (`已修改`), the default layer's value from the server's `cascadeChain` as `Default: VALUE` (`默认：VALUE`), and Reset to default. The default is spelled as an option's label, Yes or No for a boolean, and never shown for a password or encrypted key or for an object value.
- Reset is the existing draft `null` path: Save sends `null` and the badge follows the server's answer.
- An env-locked row (`resolved.locked`) gets no badge and no Reset, as before.
- The number control now shows an empty box for an unset value. With `value={null}` React left the last number on screen, so a Reset on a number row (the card's 密码最小长度) looked as if nothing happened. This is the same path the card asks for, in the same file.

PM mechanism assumptions, measured on `origin/main` 6fa842af:

- The badge: held. `sourceBadgeOf` returned `inherited` for every effective scope other than `default`, `user` and `tenant`.
- The reset button: held. It rendered only for `badge.kind === 'overrides'`.
- The page's scope: the console already had it. `GET /api/settings/:namespace` serves the manifest with `scope` on it and on each specifier, and the server's write scope per key is `spec.scope ?? manifest.scope ?? 'tenant'` (`registerManifest` in `service-settings`). No server change was needed, and `packages/**` is untouched.
- Locked values: held, unchanged.
- The org and user pages: unchanged. The existing `Overrides` and `Inherited` pins in the same file pass unmodified, and the new describe adds a `scope: 'tenant'` specifier on a global manifest as a control.

## Tests

New top-level describe `a value set on a deployment-level page (objectstack#30329)` in `SettingsView.unsetAndReset-13145.test.tsx`, the existing reset harness: the whole page over a stubbed `fetch` and the real `../api`, so the PUT body is read as it leaves the client.

- A global number value: no `Inherited from`, reads `Modified` and `Default: 8`, Reset empties the box and dirties the page, Save sends exactly `{"password_min_length":null}`, and after the re-read the row shows `8` with no badge and no Reset.
- A global toggle names `Default: No`, and a global select names its option label `Default: Lax`, each with Reset.
- CONTROL: an env-locked value, a value at its default and a `scope: 'tenant'` key on the global manifest offer no Reset; the tenant key still reads `Inherited from`; the page carries exactly three Resets.

<details><summary>Readings</summary>

- Red first, on test-only commit 753defd1 (unfixed source): `Tests 3 failed | 6 passed (9)`. The first case failed on `Inherited from` being present, the second on `Modified` missing, the third on the Reset count (0 instead of 3); every existing case passed.
- After the badge change alone, the first case failed on the number box still reading `12` after Reset (`expected '12' to be ''`), which is the number-control fix above. Then `Tests 9 passed (9)`.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run apps/console/src/pages/settings/ packages/i18n/` (every settings test, the timezone prompt that also renders `SettingsField` included, and the i18n pack parity tests), on b001f222 after merging `origin/main`: `Test Files 128 passed (128)`, `Tests 1720 passed | 13 skipped (1733)`.
- `pnpm exec turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/console --concurrency=2`: `Tasks: 74 successful, 74 total`.
- eslint on the changed ui files: 0 errors; 4 `no-explicit-any` warnings, all on lines this PR does not add (one fewer in `SettingsField.tsx` than on main).
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: 0 new citations.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran`: 35 derived families, 35 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, every exit 0 (`check-sdui-manifest.mjs` and its self-test included).

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The organization and user pages keep `Overrides Default` for a value set there, while the deployment page now reads `Modified · Default: VALUE`. That is what the dispatch asked (keep their badges); bringing the other pages to the same wording is a separate choice.
- A tenant or user key whose default is `null` and whose own value is set shows no badge and no Reset (no upper layer carries a value). Unchanged here, noted only.

## Verification

`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run apps/console/src/pages/settings/__tests__/SettingsView.unsetAndReset-13145.test.tsx`
